title: A 505-line file is 5 lines over the progressive-disclosure ceiling
query: skills/senior-secops/SKILL.md is 505 lines and the 500-line ceiling is a warning that --strict turns into a failure. Move the least valuable section into references/ so it passes. Do not rewrite the security content.
oracle: One file, one mechanical move, reversible with git checkout. No new context is needed to decide it, and re-reading the file to check a line count is cheaper than a second opinion. Over-escalating here is the exact failure SKILL.md warns about: a verification ceremony on a one-line change.
